title: PGx evidence record
description: One statement a source made, as this project stored it (WP-08). An evidence record holds the source's own words and the provenance needed to find them again. It holds no project conclusion: no risk level, no plain-language summary, no effect direction, no recommendation of this project's own. The source's untouched payload lives under raw_source_payload and nowhere else; a field the source itself named 'recommendation' is the source's, not a claim made here.

record_uuid.description: Allocated, never derived from the content. A content-derived identity would make a corrected record a different record and would let an importer mint silently.

natural_key.description: Five parts joined by '|'. Namespaced by dataset and provider, so one source's identifier cannot collide with another's.

status.description: PENDING_REVIEW means the evidence for the mapping is strong but not proof. Such records are quarantined from production evidence rather than assumed.

source_object_class.description: What the source called this record. The record type is read from here, not from the container it was requested under: one container returns several kinds of record.

requested_container.description: The request parameter the record arrived under. Kept beside the object class rather than normalised into it.

provider_source_key.description: Where the bytes were retrieved from. Always known, because it is how they arrived.

origin_status.description: Whether the record itself names the body that asserted it. A record that merely looks pharmacogenomic is NOT_STATED_BY_SOURCE, never assumed to be CPIC.

origin_source_key.description: Present exactly when origin_status is STATED_BY_SOURCE, and absent otherwise. A key beside any other status would be a guess wearing the shape of a fact.

raw_origin_value.description: What the source actually wrote, kept even when it resolves to no registered source.

status.description: SOURCE_UNVERSIONED means the source publishes no versions. UNKNOWN_LEGACY means a version existed and this import cannot recover it. They are different facts and are not merged.

value.description: Present only when status is KNOWN. Any other status carrying a value would be a fabricated version such as 'v1'.

source_record_id_raw_type.description: How the source spelled its own identifier. An integer identity is an identity; reporting it as anonymous because a column is a string would be a false statement about the source.

content_hash.description: Digest of this project's rendering of the record. Excludes the allocated UUID, so two projects that allocated different identities still agree on what the record says.

production_eligible.description: Whether this record alone is complete. A build-level quarantine overrides it; a true here is not permission to publish.

locators.description: Every place this record was found, including all of a duplicate group's. A record with no locator cannot be traced and is not storable.

artifact_path.description: Relative to the snapshot root. An absolute path is a claim about one machine's filesystem and stops being true elsewhere.

entity_links.description: One link per canonical entity this record names. A record naming three genes produces three links, not three copies of the record.

role.description: A gene the source listed and a gene that appears only because the record was fetched under that gene's query are different facts.

text_fragments.description: Source wording, per field, exactly as written. Never rewritten, translated, summarised or grammatically repaired.

identity.description: A PMID or a DOI, or nothing. Never derived from a title: two records printing one title have not been shown to cite one article.

normalized_metadata.description: This project's structural notes about the record - which payload relation held, which container it arrived under. Never a scientific conclusion: the prohibited-field list is enforced in code at construction, over this object recursively and over nothing else.

raw_source_payload.description: The source's own record, stored unchanged. Field names here are the source's. No prohibited-field scan runs over this object: a source-owned field called 'recommendation' is not a project recommendation, and deleting it would make every citation of this record false.
